BackstoryDef.title: outer tempered disciple
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years as an outer disciple of the Nine Temperings, beaten with bamboo every morning until the bamboo broke instead of the skin. The sect calls it the first tempering; [PAWN_pronoun] calls it the worst year of [PAWN_possessive] life, and the proudest.

BackstoryDef.title: stone carrier of the nine temperings
BackstoryDef.description: Outer disciples carry the stones of the sect's stairs up the mountain, one a day, for as long as it takes. [PAWN_nameDef] carried three thousand, and only then understood that the stairs were never the point.

BackstoryDef.title: inner tempered disciple
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] earned the inner rank by standing a whole night in the snow pool without moving. Inner disciples drink the blood broth of spirit beasts every evening and are allowed to spar with the core.

BackstoryDef.title: spirit beast hunter
BackstoryDef.description: The Nine Temperings need beast blood the way other sects need spirit stones. [PAWN_nameDef] hunted spirit beasts barehanded to supply the sect's broth, and has the scars of every one that fought back.

BackstoryDef.title: core tempered disciple
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a core disciple of the Nine Temperings, with bones that ring when struck. The sect has outer disciples to haul and plant; the core train, eat, sleep and train again.

BackstoryDef.title: champion of the tempering pit
BackstoryDef.description: Disputes in the Nine Temperings are settled in the tempering pit, with fists and no rules but one: nobody dies. [PAWN_nameDef] went undefeated for nine years, and once fought a Formless Sword disciple who had come to prove a sword beats a fist. [PAWN_pronoun] still says it was a draw.

BackstoryDef.title: tempering elder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an elder of the Nine Temperings, one of those who hold the hammer at the morning beatings. The Iron Mountain patriarch taught the elders that a master must have felt every blow [PAWN_pronoun] gives, and [PAWN_pronoun] has.

BackstoryDef.title: guardian of the gate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] guarded the sect's gate under Kongming, the elder who once stopped a cart of falling rocks with his back. Guardians do not move from the gate; [PAWN_pronoun] stood there through three sieges and the Convergence itself.

BackstoryDef.title: blood and bone trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] buys spirit beast blood and bones across the Rim for the sect's broth, and sells the armor its disciples refuse to wear. Few haggle with [PAWN_objective] for long.
